verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented public API that covers lists, contacts, fields, campaign reports and starting an automation for a contact. Nothing shows an endpoint that creates a campaign or broadcast, or that schedules or sends one. Reading campaign reports and triggering per-contact automations are different capabilities, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard
